fields.option_probabilities: map of caller IDs to unconditional probabilities
fields.none_probability: separate mass for native Choice only, null for Noul/Score
fields.selected_id: caller option ID or null when native none wins
fields.noul: P(yes) only for registered binary tasks
fields.score: expectation under explicitly supplied numeric levels

rules: Option IDs never enter model text; labels and criteria must be present.
No hidden renormalization or injected caller option.
Unsupported primitives/shapes and overlength inputs are errors.
